scope: non-production design and static validation only; no routing, database, provider, secret, deployment, or cutover access
abortThresholds: any source/target owner or broadcast mismatch
any duplicate source event or provider acceptance
any target result served while shadow mode is active
any queue, dead-letter, provider, or SSE threshold breach
any authentication, authorization, privacy, or schema readiness failure

steps: freeze the switch and record the audited operator and reason
stop service-authority publishers without deleting inbox, outbox, job, or provider rows
restore NOTIFICATION_WRITE_AUTHORITY=legacy and verify the legacy writer is the only writer
reconcile source/target event IDs, wallets, statuses, broadcasts, and provider IDs
reconnect SSE clients from durable replay cursors without replaying accepted provider sends
retain the rollback window and approve a new canary before any retry
